text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Was there always a ramen shop 
here?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. It's just around noon, and I've 
got time till training... Guess I'll give 
it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-!? What the heck is up with this 
menu!? There's only super spicy ramen on 
here!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't tell me, an ultra-spicy specialty 
shop... D-Damn it... I should have checked 
before walking in...!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Now then... What spice level are you? 
Plain spice? Super spice? Just spice...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Kh, b-but... if I tuck tail and run now, 
they'll make fun of me...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it all!! One super-spicy jumbo 
ramen, please!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Huff, wheeze...! I haven't even eaten 
half of it yet~...!

Struggling with the spicy food she 
couldn't handle, Espoir City ultimately 
didn't show up for training that day—
